title: AN OPEN PAUSE BOX FOLLOWS THE PAD
why: Found by the code review of 2026-10-08: the pause box key line (v19.71) was chosen only when the box opened. When a pad cable came out mid-raid the box opened on the keyboard keys, and plugging the pad back in left them up; a pad pulled out with the box already open left the pad buttons up for a keyboard player. The line now changes the moment the pad comes or goes.
now: Plugging a controller in or out while paused switches the pause box hints at once.
